title: Estimating multidimensional poverty under incomplete data in North Macedonia
abstract: arXiv:2611.14146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multidimensional Poverty Indices (MPIs) are available for more than 100 countries, but rarely below the national or regional level. Local estimates require knowing how deprivations overlap within households, yet the sources that cover every locality, such as censuses and geospatial data, cannot be linked at the household level. We show how to measure local multidimensional poverty under such incomplete data, using North Macedonia as a case study. Combining settlement-level access to services with municipal census data, we pair an independence-based point estimate with sharp bounds over all joint distributions consistent with the data. We find that, nationally, 5.01 percent of households are multidimensionally poor, with bounds of 2.01 to 17.44 percent. Also, poverty is concentrated in small rural municipalities, which are poorer than nearly all municipalities of the capital city under any dependence structure. Validating our index agains

translated_title: 在不完整数据下估计北马其顿的多维贫困
translated_abstract: 多维贫困指数（MPI）已覆盖100多个国家，但很少细化到国家或地区以下的层面。地方层面的估计需要了解家庭内部各种剥夺是如何相互重叠的，然而覆盖每个地区的数据源（如人口普查和地理空间数据）却无法在家庭层面进行关联。我们以北马其顿为案例研究，展示了如何在这种不完整数据条件下测量地方多维贫困。通过将居住点级别的服务获取数据与市级人口普查数据相结合，我们将基于独立性假设的点估计与所有与数据一致的联合分布的尖锐界限相结合。我们发现，在全国范围内，5.01%的家庭处于多维贫困状态，界限范围为2.01%至17.44%。此外，贫困集中在小型农村市镇，且在任何依赖结构下，这些市镇都比首都的几乎所有市镇更为贫困。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在不完整数据条件下估计地方层面多维贫困的新方法，通过将居住点服务数据与市级人口普查数据相结合，并用独立性点估计和尖锐界限刻画贫困范围，发现北马其顿5.01%的家庭处于多维贫困，且贫困集中在小型农村市镇。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method for estimating local multidimensional poverty under incomplete data by combining settlement-level service access data with municipal census data, pairing independence-based point estimates with sharp bounds, and finds that 5.01% of households in North Macedonia are multidimensionally poor, with poverty concentrated in small rural municipalities.
